The face computer got a price and a ship date

Consumer AR glasses stopped being a someday demo. This summer they got price tags, ship dates, and the main stage at the industry's biggest show.

01 Field notes

Snap put a price on the face computer

Snap unveiled its Specs AR glasses at Augmented World Expo in June: 2,195 dollars, preorders open, shipping this fall in the US, UK and France. A feature called EyeConnect lets two wearers share the same AR just by making eye contact.

02
In the lab

AR went to work, not just play

VITURE showed Helix, AI safety eyewear built on NVIDIA's XR platform for industrial and clinical work. The same week, Samsung revealed new glasses in the July roundups. The category is splitting into consumer and pro, and both keep getting lighter.

The winning feature is shared, not solo

Across every launch the through line is togetherness: glasses that let people see the same layer at the same moment. The lonely headset is losing to the shared overlay.
